macro.reasoning: The engine is at cycle 119 with 50 cycles of history. In the CMAPSS dataset, RUL is capped at 125 and decreases by 1 per cycle after degradation begins. The sensor readings show multiple anomalies in recent cycles (cycles 115-119), including sensor 13 at 2.90 sigma below mean, sensor 3 at 2.63 sigma below mean, and sensor 14 at 2.22 sigma above mean, indicating active degradation. Given the late cycle number and increasing anomaly frequency, the engine is near end-of-life. With 125 max RUL and 119 cycles elapsed, remaining useful life is approximately 125 - 119 = 6 cycles, but the accelerating anomalies suggest even fewer cycles remain. A conservative estimate of 1 cycle reflects the critical degradation state.
